new_learnings.text: Buy-gate saved capital today: breadth flipped from ~3:1 to 0.26:1 overnight. Opening 5 positions yesterday was aggressive but the hard_block prevented adding more exposure into what became a panic. The gating mechanism is the single most important rule in the system.
new_learnings.mechanism: Breadth can collapse in one session (费半-10.26%→A股 spillover). The gate prevents pyramiding into a falling knife. Cash is a position.

new_learnings.text: Blockbuster catalysts (新宙邦/宁德30万吨电解液协议) cannot save a stock from a -5% stop hit when the market regime is panic. Price dominates narrative — Rule 5 validated again. The stock dropped -4.2% today on the session after the catalyst announcement.
new_learnings.mechanism: Market regime beta overwhelms stock-specific alpha in panic conditions. A catalyst determines direction over weeks, but the market determines price over hours.

new_learnings.text: 恒铭达's +0.98% gain while 消费电子 sector is -4.24% suggests genuine relative strength. Stocks fighting sector gravity on day 1 of a sector selloff deserve closer monitoring rather than immediate exit. The 3-day sector-cold rule is the right balance: don't panic-sell on day 1, but don't hold indefinitely.
new_learnings.mechanism: Day-1 sector rotation often sees lagged selling in previously strong names. If the stock holds up through day 2-3 while the sector stays cold, it signals genuine institutional support.

new_learnings.text: US费半-10.26% is the largest single-day semiconductor selloff since COVID 2020. A-share tech's -2% to -5% reaction is actually contained by comparison. If the US selloff proves to be a one-day liquidation event (not a trend reversal), today's A-share dip is a buying opportunity for the strongest names. But we wait for breadth to confirm recovery before re-entering.
new_learnings.mechanism: A-share tech often under-reacts to US tech selloffs on day 1, then catches up on day 2-3. Or bounces faster if the US recovers. The asymmetry favors waiting for confirmation.
